audit_item: M0.1 / Decimal exponent range, exact fill accounting, and linear-equity reconciliation
finding: Exact Decimal helpers set operation precision but originally inherited the caller's narrow exponent bounds, so valid tiny sums/products could underflow to zero. Expanding the exponent range also exposed inherited status flags that could falsely classify a normal operation as rounded.
change: Exact addition and multiplication now use the wider supported lower exponent bound, retain the default upper finite exponent bound, clear inherited Decimal flags before each operation, and reject any operation that still signals Rounded or Inexact. Native batch/online fills and linear reconciliation use these helpers for quantity, cash, fee, funding, valuation, equity, residual, tolerance, turnover, and slippage.

regression.low_precision_reconciliation: A 12345-unit open/close at 12.34 under Decimal precision 3 reconciles expected equities 199999.99 and 199999.98 on both paths.
